chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Which of his records he likes best
summary: He cannot pick a favorite record but likes two of his own, disliking the response vocal added to one.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Of all the records you made, and it's quite a lot, which might be the ones that you feel you like best?
I couldn't tell you, really. I really couldn't tell you. There's a few that I did like, but I couldn't put no thing on any particular one. I kind of
That one with your own band.
The one that you made with (?).

Either one. Because you know why; you've got to like your own baby. But I like them both. They're both of the same type. Only one just didn't have singing on it. Mine didn't have the talking-back thing...
Where the band does the response stuff.
Yes. That vocal they do. I didn't care too much for that part. That's why I made it again, because (?) didn't want to use it.
Yes, because it tells a story in itself.
You don't need to make it obvious like that. That's like the canned laughter on TV.
But I guess they thought it was a commercial touch.
